name: claude-md-packs
description: The claude-md configuration as plugins: install the base engineering team, then add the marketing and council packs per project as needed. The security baseline (settings.json) is a separate classic install — see setup.md.

plugins.name: base
plugins.description: Core engineering team — 23 least-privilege, zero-network agents (planning, review, implementation, debugging, testing, devops, docs, curated stack experts) plus 3 skills — /caveman (terse output), secure-code-reviewer (OWASP audit), work-quality-checker (pre-send executive QA). The main install; pair it with the settings.json security baseline (see setup.md). Ships one static, no-network auto-delegation prompt hook.

plugins.name: marketing
plugins.description: 7 marketing & content agents — conversion-copywriter, content-writer, content-editor, email-campaign-writer, growth-strategist, and the config's only two network-enabled agents: content-researcher (Tavily search) and seo-rank-monitor (DataForSEO), both read-only on files — plus the shared ai-writing-tells skill (the single banned-patterns list the writers cite).

plugins.name: council
plugins.description: The 6-seat decision council (optimist, pessimist, out-of-the-box, skeptic, pragmatist, chair) plus the /council skill that fans a question to the seats and synthesizes a verdict. Pure reasoners — no network, no file writes.

plugins.name: ecc
plugins.description: A curated, security-audited subset of ECC (affaan-m/ECC, MIT): 41 agents (per-language reviewers and build-error resolvers for Go, Rust, Java, Kotlin, Swift, C#, C++, Dart/Flutter, Python, TypeScript, React, Vue, Django, FastAPI, PHP, plus TDD, refactor, accessibility, and open-source release agents), 116 engineering skills, and 34 slash-commands — an engineering core plus 10 ECC agent-engineering knowledge skills (the broader ECC harness/command machinery was trimmed for token economy). Namespaced separately from base so nothing collides; pure markdown — no scripts, hooks, or installers. Network stays governed by the settings.json baseline. See plugins/ecc/ATTRIBUTION.md.
